verdicts.reason: A keeps GET A GIFT as the dominant element and splits brand, headline and offer into sensible banner columns, but the dashed divider rules are scattered loose in the left column, the LYGOM CAFE logo and www.lygom.se are tiny, and the left-hand stack is cramped against the canvas edge. B reverses the hierarchy: 'with your next cup of coffee' is set huge, in white, directly over the busy sweater/mug photo (unwanted collision, poor legibility), while the headline GET A GIFT shrinks to a minor label. The gift icons are oversized, 'Only this Christmas' and the stars sit on the photo, and two full-width dashed lines run across the bottom for no reason, so B is unusable.
